selected_observations.excerpt:
Counterparty: Meridian Energy Partners LLC
Effective: 2 February 2024
Term: 12 months, then month-to-month.
The provider may terminate this agreement upon a change of control of Meridian Energy Partners LLC.

selection_rationale: CoC termination right must be read from MSA-MER-2024 change-of-control provisions.
known_missing_information: Contracts with only consent requirements (Helion) lack explicit termination-on-CoC language.
